changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user".staff ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, from_company_id UUID NOT NULL, to_user_id UUID NOT NULL, permissions TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by UUID, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by UUID, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_staff_from_company ON "user".staff (from_company_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_staff_to_user ON "user".staff (to_user_id);
